_note: v2.4 plan 07 T24, LIVE (real judge through the plugin, real model; so-scenario --sandbox --group 1759606632088). The warden (auto) is the metered use: a seeded fact, a scripted contradicting reply, one real warden call. The reply carries a per-run errand number: the judge client caches by request for the page session, so an identical second run is a cache hit (no tokens, cached: true), which is correct product behaviour and not the call this fixture meters. Checks: (1) the ring row carries input/output tokens and the meter moved by exactly what the row says; (2) a rollback past the reply cuts the ring row but the meter does not shrink (X23: the meter is the spend, the ring is story state); (3) the ring now shows fewer calls than the meter, which is what `so-judge cost` reports as notInRing. The judge settings are captured before the run and restored by the runner's cleanup (so-scenario judge restore, v2.4 plan 07). After a green run, re-run with --keep and compare `so-judge.mts calls --use warden --chat <id>` and `so-judge.mts cost --chat <id>` against the last eval's logged meter.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const root = ctx.extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; const status = await fetch('/api/plugins/story-orchestrator-judge/status', { headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders() }).then((response) => (response.ok ? response.json() : null)).catch(() => null); if (!status?.configured) throw new Error(`judge plugin not reachable or not configured: ${JSON.stringify(status)}`); root.settings.judge = { ...root.settings.judge, enabled: true, timeoutMs: 20000, uses: Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(root.settings.judge.uses).map((key) => [key, false])) }; globalThis.storyOrchestratorJudge.invalidateStatus(); rt.setStagecraftSettings({ curatorEnabled: false, wardenEnabled: true, wardenAcceptMode: 'auto' }); const fact = 'The old stone bridge over the river collapsed in the flood and is gone.'; if (!rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.some((entry) => entry.text === fact)) await rt.applyExtractionAudit({ id: 'v24-07-meter-seed', createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), priority: 0, reason: 'manual', contractHash: 'h', scope: [], window: { from: 100000, to: 100000 }, prompt: 'p', rawResponse: 'r', acceptedDeltas: [], rejected: [] }, [], [{ tier: 'facts', type: 'fact', importance: 3, expiration: 'permanent', entities: [], text: fact, evidence: 'the flood took the bridge' }]); if (!rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.some((entry) => entry.text === fact)) throw new Error('the seeded fact did not land in memory'); const meter = rt.getSnapshot().judgeMeter; if (!meter || typeof meter.calls !== 'number') throw new Error(`the snapshot carries no judge meter: ${JSON.stringify(meter)}`); globalThis.__soV2407 = { before: meter, length: ctx.chat.length }; return { meter };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const errand = Date.now() % 100000; const text = `I crossed the old stone bridge over the river this morning on errand ${errand}. It held firm under my boots, same as ever.`; const result = await ctx.executeSlashCommandsWithOptions(`/sendas name="Courier" raw=false "${text}"`); if (result?.isError) throw new Error(`the scripted Courier reply was not posted: ${result.errorMessage ?? ''}`); return { text };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const until = async (probe, ms) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; while (Date.now() < end) { const value = probe(); if (value) return value; await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500)); } return null; }; const state = globalThis.__soV2407; const courier = ctx.chat.findIndex((message, index) => index >= state.length - 1 && message.name === 'Courier'); if (courier < 0) throw new Error('the scripted Courier reply is not in the chat'); const call = await until(() => rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.kind === 'judge' && event.detail?.use === 'warden' && !event.detail?.fallback).at(-1), 60000); if (!call) throw new Error(`no answered warden call; journal judge events: ${JSON.stringify(rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.kind === 'judge').slice(-3))}`); if (!(call.detail.inputTokens > 0)) throw new Error(`the ring row carries no input tokens: ${JSON.stringify(call.detail)}`); const meter = rt.getSnapshot().judgeMeter; if (meter.calls < state.before.calls + 1) throw new Error(`the meter did not count the call: ${JSON.stringify({ before: state.before, after: meter })}`); if (meter.inputTokens < state.before.inputTokens + call.detail.inputTokens) throw new Error(`the meter did not add the row's tokens: ${JSON.stringify({ before: state.before, after: meter, row: call.detail })}`); state.courier = courier; state.afterCall = meter; state.ringCalls = rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.kind === 'judge').length; return { courier, row: call.detail, meter };
const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const courier = globalThis.__soV2407.courier; await ctx.deleteMessage(courier, undefined, false); return { deleted: courier, length: ctx.chat.length };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const state = globalThis.__soV2407; const meter = rt.getSnapshot().judgeMeter; const ring = rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.kind === 'judge'); const wardenLeft = ring.filter((event) => event.detail?.use === 'warden' && event.messageId >= state.courier); if (wardenLeft.length) throw new Error(`the rollback left warden rows at or after the deleted reply: ${JSON.stringify(wardenLeft.map((event) => event.messageId))}`); for (const key of ['calls', 'cachedCalls', 'inputTokens', 'outputTokens', 'cost']) if (meter[key] < state.afterCall[key]) throw new Error(`the meter shrank on rollback (${key}): ${JSON.stringify({ before: state.afterCall, after: meter })}`); const ringSent = ring.filter((event) => !event.detail?.cached && !['unavailable', 'invalid', 'disabled', 'no-roles', 'no-seam'].includes(event.detail?.fallback)).length; if (ringSent >= meter.calls) throw new Error(`the ring still shows every metered call after the rollback: ring ${ringSent}, meter ${meter.calls}`); return { meter, ringSent, notInRing: meter.calls - ringSent };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setStagecraftSettings({ wardenEnabled: false }); delete globalThis.__soV2407; return { wardenEnabled: rt.getStagecraftState().settings.wardenEnabled };
